interface_adaptations: assemble() takes extra kwargs beyond the unit card's list: results (MeasuredResult list), prior_art, graph_path, licence, status, source_root — RESULTS.md, PRIOR_ART.md, METHOD.md graph anchors and the CHECKLIST licence/PDF gates need them.

material_report accepts CopyReport | CopyPlan | Mapping | docket path. The docket-path form goes through material_report_from_docket(), which reads material/EXCERPTS.md (spans) and material/LINKS.md (over-cap stubs) and hashes the docket's own copies — never the source repo. Used to reuse U5.1's real copies for the live smoke.

MANIFEST.json is a documented superset of the plan's key list, still extra='forbid': claims[].kind (CLAIMS.md kind column), generated_at (§5 timeline), material[].linked/excerpt_reason/note (linked=True marks a LINKS.md stub that deliberately has no file on disk, so the sha256 gate can skip it).

Package re-export is assemble_docket, not assemble: re-exporting the function as 'assemble' rebinds the package attribute and shadows the resextract.docket.assemble module (monkeypatching then patches a function). 'from resextract.docket.assemble import assemble' still works.
store.init_db(path) returns a Path, not a sqlite3.Connection — tests call store.connect(path) after it.
Evidence/provenance ref grammar: optional file:/graph:/web: prefix plus #L<lo>-L<hi>; 'material/x' and 'x' both normalise to the same material dest.
CopyItem.dest is material/-relative (U5.1 behaviour), so material files live at <docket>/material/<dest>.
